title: 2026 AMC 8 Problem 19
statement: Miguel is walking with his dog, Luna. When they reach the entrance to a park, Miguel throws a ball straight ahead and continues to walk at a steady pace. Luna sprints toward the ball, which stops by a tree. As soon as the dog reaches the ball, she brings it back to Miguel. Luna runs \(5\) times faster than Miguel walks. What fraction of the distance between the entrance and the tree does Miguel cover by the time Luna brings him the ball?

solutions.text: Let the entrance-to-tree distance be \(D\), and let Miguel’s speed be \(1\). Luna’s speed is \(5\). Luna reaches the tree in time \(\frac{D}{5}\), during which Miguel walks \(\frac{D}{5}\). The remaining distance between Luna and Miguel is \(\frac{4D}{5}\), and they close it at combined speed \(6\), taking time \(\frac{2D}{15}\). Miguel walks a total distance \(\frac{D}{5}+\frac{2D}{15}=\frac{D}{3}\), which is \(\frac{1}{3}\) of the entrance-to-tree distance.
hints: After Luna reaches the tree, Miguel and Luna move toward each other
